hand_computed: N, n, the decision-point counts and LOC are counted by hand from the file; V, G, MI and the band are re-derived by scripts/mi_reference.py and checked by scripts/validate_mi_definition.py
notes: The cases where tokenising Rust is not trivial. Maximal munch makes `Vec<Vec<u8>>`-style `>>` one operator, so `<`/`>` counts are not the brace count; `&&str` is one `&&` operator token that is NOT a decision point (the preceding token is `:`); `unwrap_or_else`-style `||` here is `|| key.is_empty()`, which IS one; lifetimes `'a` are ignored while the char literal `'x'` is an operand; the attribute `#![allow(..)]` and `#[inline]` and the doc comment emit nothing; the raw string swallows a `(`; `cmp` is an operator at the call site `cmp(&self.1)` and an operand in the path `std::cmp::Ordering`; `where V: Default` is not a statement.
